title: Construction Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Pasari Group is driven by the belief that every space should actively connect with and enhance everyday life. The organization focuses on designing and building environments that positively shape perceptions and outlooks. Its philosophy, “Hello Life!”, reflects a commitment to creating spaces that feel natural, vibrant, and welcoming. Team members are encouraged to bring creativity and purpose to projects that transform how people live, work, and experience their surroundings.
  
**Role Description**
The Construction Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Kolkata Area, responsible for overseeing end-to-end construction activities across assigned projects. This position includes managing project schedules, coordinating with site engineers, contractors, and vendors, and ensuring work is executed according to design specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations. The Construction Manager will monitor daily progress, resolve on-site issues, track material usage, and support project control processes to keep timelines and budgets on target. The role also involves preparing regular status reports, conducting site inspections, ensuring compliance with local building codes, and collaborating closely with internal stakeholders to deliver projects that align with Pasari Group’s design and brand philosophy.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong Supervisory Skills to lead site teams, coordinate contractors, and manage day-to-day site operations.
* Experience in Budgeting and Project Control to plan costs, monitor expenditures, and keep projects on schedule and within financial targets.
* Solid knowledge of Construction processes, methods, and materials, with hands-on experience in building and infrastructure projects.
* Understanding of Construction Safety standards and best practices, with the ability to enforce safety protocols and regulatory compliance on site.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* Proficiency in project management tools, scheduling software, and basic MS Office applications.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to make timely decisions in a fast-paced environment.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams, clients, and external partners.
* Prior experience managing residential or commercial construction projects in an urban environment is preferred.

title: Project Manager
description:

title: SAP Payroll (ECP) Manager - India based
description:
Job description:
  
  

AKT orchestrates the future of work. We bridge the gap between people, complex organizational needs and technology. Our expertise spans the customer journeys from Talent and Skills development to Experience Management and External Workforce solutions. At AKT, we are always becoming - a culture of continuous growth dedicated to helping global brands navigate their transformation journeys with precision and purpose.

AKT is looking for an experienced SAP Payroll (ECP) Manager to oversee the delivery of end-to-end SAP payroll and Employee Central Payroll (ECP) implementations. This is a hands-on leadership position for a professional who is technically experienced in SAP Payroll and ECP who can lead and develop a team of consultants while remaining actively involved in solution design, configuration, troubleshooting, and serving as a trusted advisor to our customers.

This is a client-facing, full-time position, and open to candidates located in India.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Team Leadership & People Management:**

* Lead, mentor, develop and provide guidance to a team of SAP Payroll and ECP consultants, including workload allocation, performance management, coaching, and career development.

* Coordinate with AKT’s global delivery teams on resource planning and project execution.

**Hands-on SAP Payroll & ECP Delivery:**

* Act as the senior technical and functional escalation point for complex payroll issues, providing hands-on expertise in schemas, PCRs, wage types, payroll processing, configuration, and troubleshooting.

* Support payroll integrations between SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central, ECP, SAP HCM, and third-party systems.

* Lead payroll testing, parallel payroll runs, reconciliation, and go-live activities.

**Customer Engagement & Delivery Management:**

* Lead customers throughout implementation and support engagements, leading customer workshops, requirements discussions, solution design sessions, project reviews.

* Translate business and payroll requirements into practical, scalable SAP solutions.

* Proactively manage expectations, mitigate risks, and resolve challenges to ensure timely, high-quality delivery within scope.

**Practice Development & Operational Excellence:**

* Establish and promote delivery standards, methodologies, and best practices for SAP Payroll and ECP.

* Contribute to presales activities, including solution assessments, effort estimations, proposals, and customer presentations.

**Job Requirements:**

* Valid SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll (ECP) certification – a must

* 8+ years of hands-on SAP Payroll experience, including significant experience implementing and supporting SAP Employee Central Payroll (ECP).

* Strong functional and technical understanding of SAP Payroll configuration and processing, including Employee Central to ECP integration and payroll-related master data.

* Proven expertise in payroll schemas, PCRs, wage types, payroll control, and troubleshooting.

* Experience across the full payroll project lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, parallel runs, cutover, go-live, and post-go-live support.

* Experience managing multiple customer engagements, priorities, and delivery commitments.

* Demonstrated experience leading customer discussions and engaging with senior stakeholders.

* High proficiency in English – both verbal and written.

**Personal Skills:**

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to take ownership of complex technical and functional challenges.

* Demonstrated ability to balance people management responsibilities with hands-on project delivery.

* Dynamic team player with strong commitment and drive to accomplish individual and team tasks and goals.

* Promptly acclimate to company culture, values, processes, and expectations.

* Strong customer orientation, commercial awareness, and stakeholder management skills

* Take initiative, exercise sound judgment and result oriented.

**AKT Offers:**

* Realistic growth opportunities into either technical practices or business consulting environment

* Flexible working hours

* Stimulating and collaborative working environment

* Internal knowledge transfer, training and coaching by our dynamic team of consultants and experts

* International business environment (offices in the UK, Cyprus, DACH, India, North America, Israel, and Czech Republic)

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Senior, Tax Services**
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - SAP MM/FICO/SD integration with Direct Or Indirect Tax experience**
Are you looking to support US-based Deloitte Tax clients as they modernize and advance their tax functions? As part of Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited, this role supports Deloitte Tax LLP teams on transformation initiatives across tax, process, and technology. The position focuses on SAP-enabled tax transformation work, including direct and indirect tax processes and cross-functional integration across finance, materials management, and sales and distribution. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to large-scale client initiatives in a complex global tax environment.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Conduct user acceptance testing and compile test scenarios for newly built systems and processes.
* Identify defects and improvement opportunities in tax-related system and process designs.
* Gather and document business and tax requirements.
* Perform system fit-gap analysis for tax transformation initiatives.
* Support SAP tax transformation efforts involving FICO, MM, and SD integration.

**The team**
Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. Required:
  
  

* 6-10 years of total experience.
* 5-8 years of implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 and S4 HANA with a focus on tax and SAP FICO/MM/SD integration.
* Experience in direct and indirect tax configuration, withholding taxes, local country indirect tax localization, value-added tax customization, and reporting.
* Experience preparing functional specifications and supporting test cycles, cutovers, go-live, Hypercare, user training, and documentation.
* Experience with User Exits.
* Experience with cross-functional integration across SD-FI and MM-FI.
* MBA or Chartered Accountant with experience in finance, accounting, taxation, and audit.

* Experience with New GL, accounts receivable, accounts payable, materials management, logistics invoice verification, and asset accounting implementation.
* Experience with ONESOURCE Indirect Tax, Taxware Enterprise, Vertex O-Series, and systems such as Ariba, Coupa, Hybris, Open Text, and Read Soft.

description:
**Role Title: VP, IAM End User Operations (L14)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are
  
  
shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony, led by the Head of IAM reporting to the CISO, oversees key security functions. Direct reports specialize in authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This structure ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will be a direct report into the Head of IAM.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Synchrony Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is seeking an experienced IAM End User Operations leader to oversee and drive the operations and support of End User IAM Services. This role will lead a team responsible for delivering secure, efficient, and seamless identity and access management experiences for our end users across the organization. Acting as a critical bridge between technology, security, and business stakeholders, you will ensure operational excellence of IAM solutions, streamline user lifecycle processes, and enhance service delivery aligned with our digital transformation goals.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The ideal candidate for this role will embrace the exciting blend of technical expertise, program management, engagement ability and leadership that is required to be successful.
  
  
Specifically,
  
  

* Lead and manage the IAM End User Operations team focused on End User Services, including IAM automation engineers, administrators, and support specialists.
* Oversee day-to-day operations of user identity lifecycle management, access provisioning/de-provisioning, access reviews, self-service workflows, and password management tools.
* Drive continuous improvement in IAM operations by optimizing automation, workflows, and integration with IT service management (ITSM) platforms.
* Collaborate closely with IAM Solution Architects, Security, IT infrastructure, and business partners to ensure operational readiness, platform health, and scalability of IAM solutions.
* Develop and enforce operational standards, SLAs, and KPIs to monitor service performance and user experience quality.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and problem resolution efforts related to end-user identity and access issues.
* Ensure compliance with security policies, privacy regulations, and audit requirements (SOX, GDPR, PCI, NIST).
* Champion adoption of best practices around zero trust, privileged access, and identity governance in daily operations.
* Provide leadership, mentorship, and professional development opportunities for the operations team.
* Partner with automation and DevSecOps teams to deploy and maintain infrastructure-as-code and automated IAM provisioning processes.
* Facilitate communication and training for end-users and support teams to improve IAM awareness and compliance.
* Stay current with emerging IAM operational technologies, tools, and industry trends to continuously enhance the IAM service portfolio.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 10+ years of IT experience with a minimum of 8 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.
* Proven experience leading or managing teams responsible for IAM service delivery, identity lifecycle management, and end-user access support.
* Strong communication skills and executive presence needed.
* Knowledge of IAM tool platforms used for standard and privileged access management as well as authentication (ie. Delinea, Okta, SailPoint IIQ)
* Strong working knowledge of IAM tools such as SailPoint, Okta, Beyond Identity, Delinea, Microsoft Entra ID, and directory services like Active Directory.
* Experience managing identity provisioning, password resets, authentication services, and access governance activities at scale.
* Solid understanding of identity protocols (SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, LDAP, SCIM) in operational contexts.
* Familiarity with cloud IAM models (AWS, Azure, GCP) and integrating hybrid IAM ecosystems operationally.
* Knowledge of automation tools and DevSecOps principles applied in IAM environments (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD).
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with proven stakeholder management experience.
* Demonstrated commitment to exceptional customer service and continuous operational improvement.
* Experience working within regulatory frameworks affecting IAM operations such as SOX IT-404, GDPR, PCI, and financial industry controls.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, Okta Certified Administrator, SailPoint IdentityIQ Engineer, or similar.
* Experience managing large-scale IAM operational teams in financial services or regulated industries.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust principles as applied to IAM operations.
* Self-starter, able to adapt and thrive in a fast-changing, dynamic environment.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 10+ years of IT experience with a minimum of 8 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.
  
  
**Work Timings**
: 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM IST
  
  
(This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details.)

title: ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

Shree Rakhi is India’s largest manufacturer of Rakhis, dedicated year-round to supporting the festival of Raksha Bandhan. With over 70 years of experience, the company has been a consistent part of this cultural tradition, focusing on quality, variety, and wide accessibility. Shree Rakhi is recognized as India’s only Rakhi brand with reach across villages, towns, and cities nationwide. The organization combines heritage with modern operations, offering opportunities to contribute to a well-established, fast-moving consumer goods business.

**What We’re Looking For**

 

We are looking for an ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist with 4–6 years of relevant experience to bridge the gap between our business operations and the technical development team. We are specifically looking for someone with a deep background in the
**manufacturing industry (especially high-volume manufacturing)**

who can analyze our shop-floor processes, design robust workflows, and translate those needs into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).

This is a full-time leadership position for a strategic thinker who understands how a manufacturing business runs and knows how to map those operations flawlessly into ERPNext.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Analysis & PRD Creation:**

  Deeply understand our high-volume manufacturing operations, gather requirements from stakeholders, and write detailed, comprehensive Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for the development team to execute.
* **Workflow & SOP Management:**

  Design, map, and optimize end-to-end business workflows. Develop, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all departments (production, inventory, procurement, etc.) to ensure seamless ERP adoption.
* **Functional Solution Design:**

  Act as the architect for how ERPNext modules should be structured to solve our specific business challenges, ensuring standard out-of-the-box features are utilized effectively before requesting custom development.
* **Developer Liaison & Technical Product Management:**

  Act as the core bridge between the business stakeholders and the software developers. Prioritize the development backlog, explain business logic to coders, and guide the technical team on
  *what*

  needs to be built and
  *why*

  .
* **Testing & Quality Assurance:**

  Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that the modules developed by the technical team perfectly match the PRDs and business requirements.
* **ERPNext Configuration:**

  Handle the functional configuration and master data setup within ERPNext (e.g., BOMs, Workstations, Routing, Item Groups, Chart of Accounts).
* **User Training & Support:**

  Create training materials and provide hands-on guidance to shop-floor staff and management on how to follow the newly established ERP workflows and SOPs.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**

  Coordinate seamlessly with production, supply chain, and management teams to ensure the ERP system accurately reflects real-world manufacturing constraints and goals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Experience:**

  4–6 years of relevant experience in ERPNext functional consulting, business analysis, or technical product management.
* **Industry Knowledge:**

  Proven, extensive background in the
  **manufacturing industry**

  , with specific experience handling the complexities of
  **high-volume manufacturing**

  (production planning, inventory bottlenecks, supply chain logistics).
* **Product Management Skills:**

  Exceptional ability to write clear, structured PRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and user stories.
* **Functional Expertise:**

  Deep understanding of standard ERPNext modules (Manufacturing, Buying, Selling, Stock, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.
* **Process Mapping:**

  Strong capability in designing business workflows, process flowcharts, and implementing SOPs.
* **Analytical Skills:**

  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee business edge-cases and incorporate them into system designs.
* **Soft Skills:**

  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Must be able to speak the language of both business operators and technical developers.
* **Execution-Oriented:**

  A hands-on, structured approach to managing product timelines and ensuring development matches business goals.

**Added Advantage (Nice to Have)**

* **AI for Productivity & Coding:**

  Ability to use AI coding assistants (such as
  **Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools**

  ) to generate code snippets, prototype modules, or accelerate the development team's execution is a major plus.

**What We Value**

﻿
We value people who build trust through integrity, earn loyalty through consistency, and take ownership with a bias for action. Someone who is curious, patient, adaptable, and eager to learn, works as a team player, uses technology intelligently, and has the stability and genuine intent to grow with the organization.

title: PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator
description:
**About Us**
Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services.
  
  
**Our Mission**
Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support, and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.
  
  
Opensity Solutions delivers technology projects for professional services and enterprise clients. Our Project Managers own those projects — scope, commitments, budget, and the client relationship — and they are at their best when they are spending their time there, rather than rebuilding a resource schedule or chasing a missing time entry. The PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator takes that resource coordination load off them.
  
  
You will own the resource assignment and scheduling process across the projects you support: building and maintaining schedules against planned effort, processing modifications and confirming their downstream impact, monitoring availability and over-allocation across both project and support demand, and improving how scheduling works over time.
  
  
You will assist the PMO Director in monitoring time entry compliance in ServiceNow — reviewing entries and narratives for accuracy and routing corrections through the Project Manager and the engineer's resource manager, who are responsible for their team's accuracy.
  
  
And you will assist Project Managers with project plans, WBS structures, task records, RIDAC logs, change order documentation, recurring reporting, and meeting materials, working at their direction and with their approval.
  
  
We are looking for someone with 1–3 years in project coordination, project support, PMO analyst, scheduling, or project administration on technology projects, with hands-on exposure to a PPM platform — ServiceNow strongly preferred.
  
  
Experience with resource scheduling or assignment is the closest match to the core of this role, and experience reviewing timekeeping or billing data for accuracy is a significant advantage. Success here takes exceptional attention to detail, the willingness to hold peers to a standard, and sound judgment about which calls are yours and which belong to the Project Manager.

title: Senior Manager Quality Engineering
description:
**Role:**
Senior Manager, Quality Engineering

**Function:**
Quality Engineering / Software Testing

**Location:**
Gurugram or Kolkata

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
AI, Medical SaaS, Dental Technology

**About Company**

The company builds AI-powered SaaS for the U.S. dental market.

Its platform unifies analytics, communications, scheduling, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of solo practices, group practices, and DSOs rely on it daily.

It is a profitable SaaS business approaching eight figures in revenue. The company is mission-driven and execution-oriented — quality is designed in, not inspected in at the end.

If you want to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical and see clear, measurable impact, this is the place.

**Position Overview**

This role leads a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers and owns the modernization of how quality is built into the company's products. The mandate is to increase release confidence faster than QA headcount grows — through automation engineering, AI-assisted workflows, production observability, and shared quality ownership across Engineering, Product, and DevOps. This is a hands-on technical leadership position: the person in this role personally writes and reviews automation code, designs testing architecture, and investigates difficult production issues.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Establish a modern quality-engineering operating model based on shared ownership across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Quality Engineering; define risk-based testing strategies for critical customer workflows, integrations, and platforms.
* Own the architecture and evolution of web, API, integration, and end-to-end automation — personally build and maintain production-quality code in Playwright and TypeScript, including reusable libraries, fixtures, test-data systems, and parallel execution infrastructure.
* Integrate high-signal suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent); treat flaky and noisy tests as engineering defects and continuously improve execution speed, stability, and diagnosability.
* Define testing and evaluation strategies for AI assistants, call intelligence, and automated conversation workflows — build repeatable evaluations covering accuracy, hallucination risk, context retention, fallback logic, unsafe output, privacy, and latency.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents in daily engineering workflows across test design, automation development, code review, debugging, and incident analysis; establish practical AI-assisted workflows for the team and measure their impact on development time, maintenance effort, and release-validation speed.
* Investigate production and pre-production issues using SQL, logs, traces, API requests, browser developer tools, and monitoring platforms; lead root-cause analyses that address the architectural, testing, or observability gap that allowed a defect to escape.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers through clear goals, direct feedback, performance reviews, hiring, and career growth — raising the technical bar while scaling quality through better systems rather than linear headcount.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 8+ years in software quality, test automation, or quality engineering, including 3+ years of people leadership managing and developing engineers.
* 4+ years of hands-on automation experience; personally written, reviewed, debugged, and maintained production automation code within the last 12 months.
* Strong software engineering ability in TypeScript or JavaScript; experience designing automation systems from the ground up, not only scripting within an existing framework.
* Strong experience with Playwright for browser automation and API testing; candidates from Selenium or Cypress must demonstrate current coding ability and a track record of modernizing legacy automation architecture.
* Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent) and improving execution reliability, speed, and diagnosability.
* Practical, current use of AI coding assistants or agents — able to describe specific workflows, measurable benefits, limitations encountered, and a concrete case where AI output was confidently wrong and how it was caught.
* Strong production-debugging skills using SQL, logs, traces, observability systems, and network-level tooling; demonstrated track record of improving quality without proportional growth in manual QA headcount.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience testing AI assistants, LLM-powered products, conversational systems, call intelligence, or automated communication workflows.
* Background in healthcare SaaS, dental technology, VoIP, payments, or other business-critical platforms.
* Experience with mobile automation, distributed architectures, third-party integrations, and asynchronous processing.
* Exposure to performance, reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, or observability testing.
* Track record of transforming a traditional QA team into a modern Quality Engineering organization.

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of a high-impact, technically ambitious quality engineering mandate at a profitable, product-led SaaS company.
* Direct influence on architecture, tooling, and AI-assisted engineering practices across a cross-functional team.
* Autonomy and flexible scheduling within a mission-driven, execution-oriented culture.
* Opportunity to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical with clear, measurable customer impact.
* Support for technical growth, career development, and contribution as a genuine engineering partner — not a process gatekeeper.

* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.

* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Team:**
The Manager - Engineering (Electrical & Instrumentation) reports to the Senior Manager - Engineering & Projects and provides functional leadership for plant instrumentation, automation, control systems and associated electrical systems.
  
  
You will be accountable for PLC/SCADA reliability, filling-line controls, field instrumentation, calibration, interlocks, control panels and automation projects, while ensuring essential electrical power reliability and statutory compliance.
  
  
You will work across Production, HSSE, Quality, IT/OT, Procurement, contractors and the Mechanical Engineering Manager to deliver safe, reliable and cost-effective operations.
  
  
**Key Tasks:**
Own reliability and lifecycle performance of PLCs, SCADA, HMIs, filling-line controls, industrial networks, safety interlocks and control panels.
  
  

* Lead maintenance and troubleshooting of sensors, encoders, photoelectric and proximity devices, load cells, weighing systems, flow meters, transmitters, control valves, actuators, printers, labelers and vision interfaces.
* Plan preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance to improve asset availability, MTBF and MTTR.
* Ensure calibration, functional testing and traceability of instruments, weighing systems, alarms, trips and protective devices.
* Maintain controlled PLC/SCADA programs, backups, access controls, software revisions, I/O lists, cause-and-effect matrices, alarm/interlock lists, loop drawings and network architecture.
* Lead root-cause analysis and defect elimination for recurring filling-line, PLC, instrumentation and control-system failures.
* Deliver E&I scope for CAPEX and minor projects from concept, specification and technical bid evaluation through FAT/SAT, commissioning, performance verification and handover.
* Drive automation, digitization, data acquisition, predictive maintenance and process-control improvements with measurable business value.
* Manage critical spares, obsolescence risks, AMCs, vendors, contractors and assigned expenditure within approved budgets.
* Coach engineers and technicians in PLC diagnostics, calibration, filling-line controls, safe isolation and structured troubleshooting.
* Ensure essential electrical systems including HT/LT distribution, MCC/PCC, motors, VFDs, UPS, DG interfaces, earthing and protection remain safe, reliable and compliant.

Responsible for HSSE in Engineering (both people and equipment) activities and compliance to Castrol HSSE standards.
  
  
The person with be responsible as Contractor Assurance Manager (CAM) to manage the contractors at site for HSSE & Legal requirements for contract.
  
  
The person will be responsible for Castrol Engineering Standards specifically Integrity Management Standards application for Engineering activities at site.
  
  
**Experience Required:**
Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation & Control, Electronics & Instrumentation, Electrical & Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent recognized engineering qualification.
  
  

* Preferably 8-10 years of instrumentation, automation, maintenance and project experience in manufacturing or process industries, including team and contractor responsibility.
* Strong knowledge of PLC programming, diagnostics, I/O systems, SCADA, HMI, industrial communication networks, control loops, alarms, trips and interlocks.
* Hands-on experience with filling-line automation, sensors, encoders, load cells, weighing/filling systems, control valves, actuators, printers and labellers.
* Knowledge of Allen-Bradley PLC and SCADA platforms is an added advantage.
* Experience in calibration, loop checking, FAT/SAT, commissioning, functional testing, performance testing and as-built documentation.
* Working knowledge of MCC/PCC, motors, VFDs, UPS, DG interfaces, protection, earthing and electrical drawings.
* Understanding of OT lifecycle controls including backups, access control, change management, recovery planning and cybersecurity coordination.
* Good project management, contractor management, communication, planning and commercial-judgement skills; proficiency in MS Project and MS Office is desirable.

We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy.response@castrol.com.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.).*

title: Principal Engineer - Bridges
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
We are seeking an accomplished
**Principal Engineer**
-
**Bridges**
to drive the domestic delivery and support strategic growth within our Transport Structures team. This senior role is central to strengthening our position in India’s bridge market—especially in complex projects, major infrastructure bids, and capture management for priority pursuits.
  
  
You will play a key role in steering high‑quality technical outputs, leading teams on complex structures, and shaping winning strategies for major tenders. With deep structural background and proven leadership across design and bidding cycles, you will help elevate our technical excellence, expand client relationships, and support the successful delivery of iconic design and build bridge projects across India and overseas. In this role you will provide
  
  
**Technical Leadership**

* Direct and manage design for long‑span bridges, complex structures, and other transportation structures in multi-disciplinary infrastructure projects
* Provide technical direction, guidance, and mentorship to junior engineers and cross-functional project teams.
* Responsible for managing quality assurance in project delivery, complying to Jacobs Quality Management systems.
* Support clients in technical decision-making, providing opening and middle game support in strategic pursuits, providing robust engineering solutions.

**Project Delivery**

* Oversee design schedule, resources, budget, and deliverables to ensure timely and high‑quality outcomes, keeping our clients delighted.
* Coordinate effectively with clients, contractors, consultants, internal teams and all other relevant stakeholders throughout all design stages.

**Bidding & Capture Management**

* Drive the preparation of technical proposals, scope of Works, resource plans, and financial estimates for domestic infrastructure bids, benchmarking with the market standards and requirements.
* Partner closely with business development teams to shape winning strategies for major pursuits
* Lead capture planning efforts for long‑span bridges/major crossings, and transport structure opportunities

**Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to organizational quality standards, industry regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Conduct technical reviews, risk assessments, and ensure appropriate mitigation strategies are implemented.

**Client & Market Engagement**

* Build and nurture relationships with key clients, government agencies, and major industry partners.
* Stay connected to the domestic infrastructure market to identify early opportunities and support pursuit strategies.
* Represent the organization at technical forums, client meetings, and industry events.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering (Structures specialization preferred).
* Minimum of 15 years of experience in bridge design and projecy delivery.
* Extensive background in domestic infrastructure projects, including highways, railways, and urban development. Having exposure to international clients will be preferred.
* Proven experience preparing proposals and bids for government and private sector clients in domestic market.
* Proficiency in structural analysis and design software such as STAAD Pro, MIDAS, etc.
* Comprehensive knowledge of IRC, IRS, IS codes, and MoRTH specifications. Exposure to international standards like AASHTO and Eurocodes will be preferred.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills.
* Ability to work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. supporting the
**o9 Solutions IBP platform**
. The role provides

This position acts as the technical integration authority within the IBP CoE. It combines architecture, delivery, operations, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder leadership. This person will work closely with functional leads, the Solution Architect, data teams, infrastructure and security teams, implementation partners, and business stakeholders to ensure that integrations are production-ready and sustainably transitioned into support.
  
  
**Role Purpose and Outcomes**

* Own the o9 INT3.0 integration workstream and provide practical, recent implementation expertise with minimal dependency on project-team knowledge transfer.
* Establish stable, traceable, and supportable inbound and outbound interfaces for IBP planning processes.
* Improve operational resilience through runbooks, batch monitoring, error-log knowledge, root-cause analysis, and repeatable recovery procedures.
* Enable faster and safer releases by applying technical design standards, quality controls, and disciplined deployment practices.
* Support targeted Python-based plug-ins, procedures, and automation under the guidance of functional and solution leads.

**What You'll Do**
**Key Responsibilities**
**o9 Integration 3.0 Technical Ownership**

* Act as the primary technical owner for o9 Integration 3.0 across design, build, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Design and maintain integration patterns for master, transactional, planning, and analytical data exchanged between o9 and enterprise systems.
* Assess integration requirements, define technical options, document decisions, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and security standards.
* Provide technical guidance to internal teams, vendors, and implementation partners, and review integration deliverables for quality and maintainability.

**Integration Engineering and Data Flows**

* Develop, configure, enhance, and troubleshoot data ingestion and extraction pipelines, transformations, orchestration, schedules, and dependencies.
* Work with ERP, data-platform, middleware, cloud, and data-provider teams to define interface contracts, mappings, validation rules, cadence, and ownership.
* Ensure integrations correctly handle full and delta loads, sequencing, reconciliation, restorability, exceptions, and downstream dependencies.
* Perform technical analysis of complex data issues and distinguish source-data, transformation, configuration, platform, and infrastructure causes.

**Batch Operations, Monitoring and Support**

* Own batch-flow visibility, operational monitoring, issue triage, and technical coordination for failed or delayed integrations.
* Create and maintain batch runbooks, support procedures, error-log libraries, escalation paths, and recovery instructions that are specific to the implemented landscape.
* Lead root-cause analysis for recurring incidents and convert findings into preventive controls, automation, or design improvements.
* Support production releases, continuous improvement through Change Requests, and transition to steady-state operations, including knowledge transfer to data and support teams.

**Technical Development and Automation**

* Use Python where appropriate to develop plug-ins, procedures, utilities, validations, and automation that complement o9 configuration and integration capabilities.
* Apply sound software-engineering practices including version control, modular design, code review, logging, exception handling, testing, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with functional experts to translate planning requirements into safe and maintainable technical extensions without compromising platform standards.

**Quality, Security and Release Governance**

* Define and apply technical quality gates for integration design, code, configuration, testing evidence, deployment readiness, and documentation completeness.
* Prepare unit, system-integration, regression, performance, and reconciliation test scenarios in collaboration with QA and functional teams.
* Ensure secure handling of credentials, access, data transfers, service accounts, certificates, and environment-specific configuration in line with approved policies.
* Identify technical debt, performance risks, and single points of failure, and maintain a prioritized improvement roadmap.

**Agile Delivery and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Author and refine technical user stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, estimates, dependencies, and implementation plans.
* Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and defect-triage forums.
* Communicate technical risks, decisions, and recovery options clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor less-experienced technical resources and strengthen internal integration capability through structured knowledge sharing.

**What We're Looking For**
**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 1 year of hands-on o9 INT3.0 integration experience.
* Recent delivery experience on o9 implementation projects, with demonstrated ownership of Integration 3.0 work and implementation outcomes.
* Strong practical knowledge of o9 INT3.0 concepts, tools, deployment patterns, batch processing, operational monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience integrating with SAP or other ERP systems, data platforms, middleware, file-transfer services, and cloud environments.
* Strong SQL and data-engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, dependency management, and performance analysis.
* Working Python programming experience for plug-ins, procedures, validation utilities, or automation.
* Experience with APIs, structured files, secure file transfer, authentication methods, scheduling or orchestration, and environment promotion practices.
* Experience producing technical integration designs, data-flow diagrams, interface specifications, deployment plans, runbooks, and support documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to work in agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Certifications**

* o9 Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) certification is required; equivalent demonstrable expertise must be supported by recent project evidence.
* Additional o9 technical, platform, configuration, performance, or analytics certifications are valued.
* Relevant cloud, data engineering, integration, security, agile, or project-management certifications are advantageous.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in global IBP or supply-chain planning programs spanning Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP/IBP, and KPI or analytics solutions.
* Experience operating in a Center of Excellence model and transitioning implementation knowledge into internal support ownership.
* Exposure to customer-managed cloud or Azure-based deployments, enterprise identity integration, and secure data-transfer patterns.
* Experience improving batch performance, observability, error handling, and resilience in business-critical planning landscapes.
* Ability to contribute across integration architecture and hands-on delivery while maintaining a clear separation between standard platform configuration and custom development.

**Behavioural And Leadership Skills**

* Technical ownership: takes accountability for outcomes, follows issues through resolution, and makes risks visible early.
* Analytical problem solving: structures ambiguous technical problems, tests hypotheses, and produces evidence-based conclusions.
* Communication: explains complex integration behavior to both engineering teams and business stakeholders in clear language.
* Collaboration: works effectively across functional consultants, architects, data teams, infrastructure, security, vendors, and business users.
* Quality mindset: values documentation, repeatability, traceability, and sustainable support over short-term fixes.

**Success Measures**

* Reliable execution of scheduled integrations with clear monitoring, ownership, and recovery procedures.
* Reduced recurrence and resolution time of integration incidents through root-cause elimination and better operational knowledge.
* Complete, current, and usable technical documentation for interfaces, batches, error handling, deployments, and support.

title: TMF Lead

**Job Description:**
JOB TITLE: TMF Lead
  
  
LOCATION: India (Remote)
  
  
**Job Overview**
The TMF Lead is responsible for day-to-day TMF leadership for assigned clinical studies. The role coordinates study TMF activities, provides status and risk information to stakeholders, and directs the work of supporting TMF Specialists and Associates. The TMF Lead creates and maintains the TMF Plan, leads or creates the TMF build, and coordinates periodic TMF quality control and remediation with oversight from TMF management.
  
  
**Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Coordinates TMF activities across the lifecycle of assigned studies and serves as the routine TMF contact for the study team.
* Creates, maintains, and implements the study-specific TMF Plan and associated records with review and approval from the Project Manager and Sponsor.
* Leads the initial TMF build for assigned studies, including structure, expected document packages and ad hoc placeholder creation in accordance with approved standards.
* Maintains TMF expectations as study scope, milestones, countries, sites, vendors, or responsibilities change.
* Plans and coordinates periodic TMF QC in accordance with the TMF Plan and procedures, including assignment, completion tracking, documentation, and follow-up.
* Reviews periodic QC findings, coordinates remediation, verifies completion, identifies repeat issues, and escalates significant trends or unresolved actions.
* Monitors TMF completeness, quality, and timeliness and provides regular status reports to study and functional stakeholders.
* Coordinates document collection, review, indexing, filing, reconciliation, and issue resolution across internal and external contributors.
* Identifies and investigates missing, incomplete, inconsistent, late, or misfiled documents and assigns or escalates corrective actions.
* Provides task direction, priorities, and technical guidance to TMF Specialists and Associates supporting assigned studies.
* Participates in study meetings and communicates TMF requirements, status, risks, actions, and upcoming milestones.
* Interacts directly with sponsors to provide TMF status updates, discuss risks and actions, confirm expectations, and support study decisions within delegated authority.
* Supports audit and regulatory inspection readiness, document retrieval, response preparation, and remediation.
* Coordinates final TMF review, reconciliation, closeout, transfer, archival, and sponsor return activities.
* Provides TMF training and eTMF system support to TMF Specialists and Associates, study team members, sponsors, and other users and escalates system issues when required.
* Escalates material risks, recurring quality issues, resource concerns, and decisions outside delegated authority.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by departmental management.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
No routine direct supervisory responsibility. Provides study-level task direction and technical guidance to TMF Specialists and Associates assigned to the study.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
EDUCATION
  
  

* College or university degree. A healthcare, life science, information management, or related degree is a plus.
* An equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* Typically minimum of six years of experience in TMF, records management, clinical operations, or a related regulated function.
* Experience coordinating TMF activities and working with cross-functional study teams.
* Experience creating or maintaining TMF Plans, supporting or leading TMF builds, and coordinating periodic TMF QC is preferred.

**Skills/Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with global internal and external study teams
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office and electronic Trial Master File systems
* Knowledge of the clinical trial lifecycle, essential documents, and applicable TMF requirements
* Knowledge of ICH Good Clinical Practice and applicable regulatory requirements
* Exceptional attention to detail and a consistent focus on document quality
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and timelines
* Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and changing environment
* Demonstrates honesty, trust, fairness, cooperation, self-control, and flexibility
* Strong working knowledge of TMF structure, essential documents, metadata, and records lifecycle activities
* Strong coordination, facilitation, problem-solving, and escalation skills
* Ability to interpret reports and QC findings and coordinate appropriate remediation
* Ability to work independently within approved plans, procedures, and delegated authority

**Capabilities**

* Able to work flexible hours to accommodate study team and sponsor requirements
* Able to travel based on study and business need
* Able to perform office-based or remote work as assigned
* Minor lifting of less than 30 pounds may be required

title: Oracle Fusion - Tax Technology Services II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Fusion Tax – Consultant, Tax Technology Services**
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as the Netherlands, United Kingdom etc.) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
**At Deloitte**
, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.
  
  
**Your Team**
Within Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.
  
  
As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledgeable about the Oracle applications functionality, with experience in Oracle Tax, in Cloud and/or eBS
* Familiar with Oracle Cloud tools, templates and methods, and finance transformation delivery models (e.g., Waterfall, Agile)
* Work as part of the project team to analyse the client’s tax and business requirements and build the optimal Oracle Tax design or supplement with the right mix of alternative technology solutions such as indirect tax determination engines, indirect tax compliance technology, or offline processes
* Work alongside the project team to assess the key tax touchpoints across the end-to-end business processes and address the client’s particular tax requirements
* Work with the project team to document new requirements, finalize system design, complete system integration testing and support user acceptance testing
* Able to think logically while solving problems and present clear recommendations to our clients as part of suggested resolution
* Work with Oracle Support to address system issues/ bugs and present a workable solution which addresses the client’s requirement
* Provide regular updates to key stakeholders on product development processes, costs and budgets, achievements against plan etc.
* Mentor and train junior colleagues in the team
* Participate in development and delivery of training sessions either to the client or internally across the team
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
* Continually research current and emerging functionality (Oracle or others) and propose changes as part of Deloitte’s Oracle offering
* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant or bachelor’s in finance/ technology from reputed University with overall experience in Finance, Accounting and/ or Taxation
* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge
* Ability to understand client requirements, develop and suggest appropriate solution or workarounds in Oracle
* Able to work with Oracle support to flag/fix issues – raising SRs and conducting OWC to explain problems and discuss workarounds
* Proficient in preparing client-ready project deliverables i.e., requirement framework documents, key design decision documents, configuration documents, functional specification documents, test scripts and training guides
* Has knowledge of configuration migration through “Rapid Implementation Spreadsheet” and data migration through Oracle tools like ADFDi, Desktop Integrator, FBDi templates
* Proficient in planning work as per deadline and coordinating with the team to complete work within stipulated deadline
* Comfortable communicating with members from other workstreams and able to collaborate to discuss and test solutions which has cross-workstream dependencies
* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

**Preferred**

* Some knowledge of SQL script, OTBI and/ or BI Publisher would be preferable
* Experience of other Oracle modules and processes, and knowledge of tax touchpoints in other Oracle modules e.g., Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, General Ledger, Consolidation

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Strategy Associate- Clinical
description:
Strategy Associate – Clinical Services,

Research & Evaluation

Department: CEO’s Office

Location: Kolkata, West Bengal

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: Minimum 5 years

Compensation: Up to ₹10 LPA

Qualification: MA/MSc in Psychology

Role Overview

India Autism Center (IAC) is building an integrated ecosystem of clinical services, vocational

development, research, training, and residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum

and their families.

We are looking for a Strategy Associate with a background in psychology, research, and

programme evaluation to strengthen strategic performance monitoring across IAC, with a

specialist focus on clinical services, vocational programmes, the training academy, learning and

development, and research.

You will play a key role in evaluating programme effectiveness, service quality, implementation

progress, resource utilisation, and outcomes. The role will combine quantitative and qualitative

analysis with structured performance reviews to identify gaps, assess underlying causes,

recommend improvements, and monitor follow-through.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Performance Monitoring

● Monitor departmental plans, programmes, and organisation-wide strategic priorities

against agreed objectives, deliverables, quality standards, resource requirements,

budgets, and timelines.

● Review progress across clinical services, vocational programmes, the training academy,

learning and development, and research.

● Monitor relevant indicators such as programme milestones, service quality, participant

outcomes, staff training effectiveness, research deliverables, and implementation

progress.

● Identify deviations from planned outcomes, analyse underlying causes, and track agreed

corrective actions.

2. Strategic Evaluation & Review

● Develop or apply monitoring and evaluation frameworks, performance indicators,

evaluation criteria, and reporting mechanisms across departments, programmes,

projects, and strategic initiatives.

● Assess programme implementation, service quality, participant outcomes, training

effectiveness, research progress, and adherence to established standards, as

applicable.

● Review relevant workflows, documentation, assessment processes, referral pathways,

follow-up mechanisms, and service continuity within the scope of established protocols.

● Identify recurring gaps, implementation bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement;

prepare evidence-based findings and recommendations.

● Coordinate internal reviews and audits where required, document observations, and

track agreed corrective actions through closure.

3. Policies, Systems & Process Implementation

● Identify gaps in organisational and programme systems and support the development of

appropriate structures, policies, SOPs, workflows, indicators, and accountability

mechanisms.

● Map and evaluate programme workflows, participant journeys, research processes,

training pathways, and service-delivery mechanisms.

● Monitor the adoption and effectiveness of established processes across relevant

departments.

● Evaluate the implementation of evidence-based practices and staff development

initiatives, where applicable.

4. Risk Monitoring & Management

● Monitor risks relating to programme implementation, service quality, documentation,

research milestones, staff capacity, resource constraints, and delivery timelines.

● Maintain relevant risk registers and track mitigation plans in collaboration with

accountable teams.

● Identify emerging risks, recurring quality concerns, and deviations from established

standards.

● Escalate material concerns to the leadership and monitor agreed mitigation actions

through closure.

● Respect confidentiality, ethical research requirements, and responsible handling of

participant and organisational data.

5. Research, Data Analysis & Leadership Reporting

● Consolidate quantitative and qualitative data from relevant departments and assess its

completeness, consistency, and usefulness for decision-making.

● Analyse participant feedback, programme outcomes, service-quality indicators, training

results, research milestones, and other relevant evidence.

● Prepare dashboards, evaluation reports, management summaries, and presentations for

departmental and organisation-wide reviews.

● Translate findings into clear insights and practical recommendations for leadership.

6. Cross-functional Coordination & Accountability

● Work with clinical, vocational, training, research, learning and development, and

operational teams to review performance and understand implementation challenges.

● Facilitate periodic reviews, document agreed actions, identify accountable owners, and

monitor completion against deadlines.

● Identify dependencies between programme teams and other organisational functions

that may affect delivery.

● Escalate persistent performance gaps, unresolved actions, and material risks through

the established reporting structure.

Key Outcomes

● Reliable evidence on programme effectiveness, service quality, research progress, and

organisational performance.

● Stronger visibility into departmental progress against agreed objectives, quality

standards, resource requirements, and timelines.

● Early identification of implementation gaps, risks, and recurring performance issues.

● More consistent use of monitoring and evaluation frameworks and evidence-based

recommendations.

● Stronger implementation of organisational systems, documentation standards, and

improvement actions.

● Timely, accurate reports that support leadership decisions and continuous improvement.

Must-have Requirements

● 5 years of relevant experience in monitoring and evaluation, programme evaluation,

research, quality assurance, clinical or educational operations, or service-quality

management.

● MA/MSc in Psychology or a related discipline.

● Demonstrated ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data and evaluate

programme or organisational performance.

● Experience preparing reports, reviewing processes, documenting findings, and

recommending improvements.

● Strong analytical, research, documentation, communication, and

stakeholder-coordination skills.

● Proficiency in spreadsheets, data analysis, and reporting tools.

● Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and follow through on agreed

actions.

● Understanding of confidentiality and ethical handling of sensitive information.

Preferred Skills

● Experience with monitoring and evaluation frameworks, logic models, outcome

measurement, or programme evaluation.

● Familiarity with clinical, educational, vocational, psychosocial, or disability-service

settings.

● Exposure to research methodologies, statistical analysis, and qualitative data analysis.

● Knowledge of quality assurance, service standards, assessment protocols, or

evidence-based practices.

● Experience evaluating training, competency development, or programme

implementation.

● Experience working in healthcare, education, research, non-profit, or social-impact

organisations.

About India Autism Center

India Autism Center is a not-for-profit organisation building a comprehensive ecosystem of

support, training, research, and lifelong residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum

and their families. IAC works towards greater independence, dignity, belonging, and quality of

life for individuals and families across India.
