title: Plant Superintendent- PJM Area
description:
**Plant Superintendent**
**About PROENERGY**
PROENERGY is an engineering, R&D, and manufacturing powerhouse. The company addresses every need for fast-start power generation: turbine and package manufacturing, turnkey project execution, power purchase agreements, and asset lifecycle care for turbines and plants. Where others see impossible energy challenges, PROENERGY provides innovative aeroderivative solutions.
  
  
**Our Footprint**
PROENERGY delivers fast-start, dispatchable power solutions from worldwide centers for aeroderivative excellence. We are investing more than $1 billion through 2028 in infrastructure to serve our customers.
  
  
**In Sedalia, Missouri,**
our 600,000 sq ft Center for Excellence in Manufacturing—a world-class investment in fast-start power and the only campus of its kind in the world—is growing by 40 percent.
  
  
**In Houston, Texas,**
our 500,000 sq ft Center for Excellence in Lifecycle Care features a Level-IV depot and aero repair facility, which executes comprehensive services for aeroderivative engines under one roof.
  
  
In
**Kansas City**
, we have an office with an Engineering team that supports our sought-after solutions for turnkey projects and contracted power.
  
  
And our
**worldwide service centers**
ensure local service expertise near our customers. Our expanding service footprint includes Phoenix, Buenos Aires, New Brunswick, and additional locations in Europe, Australia, and Southeast Asia.
  
  
**Our Philosophy**
We take care of our people and strive to make a positive difference for the world. We offer competitive pay, excellent benefits that include Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life/Disability Insurance at minimal cost to the employee, 10 paid holidays, paid time off, and a 401K plan. If you are looking for a rewarding career and possess specialized knowledge and quality-oriented problem-solving skills, we encourage you to apply today.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Plant Superintendent serves as the interface between the asset owner (Origin Mine) or their agent, ProEnergy Services, and the plant O&M team to accomplish the safe operation of the asset while achieving reliability and availability goals. The Plant Superintendent is fully accountable for financial planning and control, provision of resources, compliance with regulatory requirements, and various communication and reporting requirements within the contractual terms of the O&M Agreement. Additionally, the plant Superintendent will manage the daily operations of the plant, directs the implementation of the Operating Plan, identifies those areas which may need improvement or further development, and is responsible for overseeing the maintenance and repair of plant facilities and equipment.
  
  
**Reports To:**
Director O&M
  
  
**Work Location:**
PJM Area
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**

* Develop long term operation plans and align daily activities to these objectives.
* Achieve safety, financial, reliability, availability and efficiency goals.
* Establish effective and sustainable operations.
* Establish a culture of compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.
* Establish effective maintenance and outage planning and execution.
* Establish a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
* Provide excellent customer satisfaction.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Build a strong team of motivated people to achieve business goals.
* Establish and maintain effective relationship with contacts to include the owner, the public and co-workers.
* Manages contract compliance requirements to include plant permits and related data collection and record keeping.
* Manages compliance with federal, state and local regulations, laws and practices.
* Interprets company policies to workers and enforces safety regulations.
* Reads, understands, and ensures compliance with all plant safety and regulatory procedures.
* Initiates plans to motivate workers to achieve work goals.
* Establish work management practices and monitor KPIs to ensure the process achieves plant goals.
* Establish budgets and control operating costs within budgetary constraints.
* Coordinate site activities with commercial function to optimize financial performance and risk.
* Collaborate with other PES plant Superintendents, Plant Managers, and company subject matter experts to coordinate activities and identify and spread best practices.
* Provide and utilize various financial, production, process and performance reports.
* Reviews purchase orders for parts, ensuring budgetary constraints are maintained.
* Establish procedures to procure and protect spare parts
* Contract services appropriate to achieve reliability and availability goals.
* Implements changes in working conditions and use of equipment to increase efficiency of plant or work crew.
* Reads, understand and assist staff with the use of technical manuals and system piping and instrumentation diagrams.
* Prepares or reviews work orders for required preventative and corrective maintenance.
* Assists workers in proactively identifying failing equipment and diagnosing malfunctions in machinery and equipment.
* Interprets specifications, blueprints, and job orders to workers, and assigns duties.
* Establishes or adjusts work procedures to meet maintenance schedules.
* Recommends and implements measures to improve methods, equipment performance, and quality of service.
* Analyzes and resolves work problems or assists workers in solving work problems.
* Directs workers engaged in dismantling, assembling, and installing industrial machinery.
* Develop schedules and estimates worker hour requirements for completion of job assignment.
* Create and maintain monthly production and performance report for owner
* Leads recruitment effort for Operations employment candidates and assures complete and proper professional safety training and orientation for the OMT members.
* Takes the lead in investigating and resolving all forced outages and operating irregularities. Reviews and makes recommendations to improve equipment availability, performance, and reliability.
* Develops and oversees training and qualification programs to maximize the effectiveness of the Operational staff. Provides overall coordination for Operational departments training and development including budgeting and scheduling.
* Develops plans for the execution of planned outages. Ensures that work performed by plant personnel and contractors is planned and progresses as scheduled to meet performance and cost objectives.
* Oversees a comprehensive maintenance program that includes preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance programs in accordance with PES, manufacturer and industry practice and as indicated by equipment and system performance, maintenance records and safety requirements. Continually evaluates the maintenance program and adjusts conditions to optimize maintenance cost effectiveness, work quality, outage time and availability. Reviews maintenance actions taken on work order forms.
* Reviews and improves operational & maintenance processes and ensures that personnel adhere to established procedures and practices. Develops action plans to align employee accountabilities and conduct with operational processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree and six to eight years related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Technical competence including understanding software, hardware, networks, etc.
* Ability to analyze and resolve problems in a logical and effective manner.
* Experience with operations and maintenance of LM6000.
* US work authorization is a precondition of employment. The company will not consider candidates who require sponsorship for a work-authorized visa.
* Successful candidate will need to satisfactorily complete pre-employment drug screen and background check.

**Additional Requirements/Expectations**

* Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.
* Proficient in the use of various MS Office Suite programs, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

+ Revenue Recognition
+ Accruals
+ Intercompany Reconciliation
+ Manual Journal Entries and Automation
+ Asset Accounting
+ Chart of Accounts & Accounting Master Data
+ Account Reconciliation (e.g., Cash & Bank, Sales)
+ Subledger Accounting
+ Consolidation

+ Notes and Disclosures
+ Cost Accounting & Inventory

* Drive consolidation process design and execution, including:

+ Defining consolidation data structures
+ Managing mapping between operational COA and Group COA / FS items
+ Ensuring effective use of tools such as SAP Group Reporting, SAP BPC, Oracle FCCS

* Lead the workstreams or delivery teams within large transformation programs, ensuring timely delivery, quality outcomes, and stakeholder alignment.
* Define and implement AI-driven solutions and automation opportunities in R2R processes, evaluating available tools and driving their practical application in enterprise environments.

**Business Development & Solution Development -**

* Lead pursuit teams to understand client problem statements & formulate that in solutions
* Lead developing client specific solutions for the engagement team
* Lead proposal development or lead proposal teams
* Lead collaboration with market teams to develop relationship and drive business growth for EY
* Collaborate cross service lines to ensure smooth execution of the project.
* Lead development of internal capability development and lead training sessions to coach internal teams to develop capability
* Lead operational initiatives within the practice areas.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Subject Matter and Technical Skills -**

* Deep knowledge in Record to report, invoice to pay and Order to cash areas
* Certification and/or sound experience based knowledge in ERPs like SAP S/4 HANA FI/CO/COPA, SAP Central Finance, Oracle Fusion Finance, Oracle Netsuite
* Certification and/or sound experience based knowledge in digital finance solutions like Blackline, Trintech, High Radius, Different RPA solutions
* Knowledge about AI/ML/Gen-AI & Analytics solution in finance space particularly in Record to Report areas.
* Knowledge of consolidation, reporting, inter-company and ERP data structures
* Have experience in current state analysis (As is), future state analysis (To be), process optimization, data optimization, data analytics, data management

**Business Skills And Knowledge –**

* Strong business development skills
* Very strong solution conceptualization/ideation skill
* Strong solution/product build skills
* Strong project management skills

**Human Skills –**

* Excellent written & oral communication & articulation
* Flexible work attitude
* Proven ability to lead diverse team over multiple geographies
* Strong collaboration skills
* Ability to comprehend complexity quickly & apply solutions
* Comfort in dealing with ambiguity
* Strong entrepreneurial skills in terms of ownership of problem & solutions
* Strong problem solving skills
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure and deliver results
* Willingness to travel for short or long duration at short notice

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CA, MBA (Finance) with Commerce Background, CWA, CMA, CFA, M.Com
* 2-4 Years of relevant consulting experience in record to report transformation (not Industry user experience)
* Experience of working with international clients preferred
* Experience with previous multinational consulting firms or Big4 firms

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.
  
  
You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
  
  
Role Description
  
  
As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
  
  
You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
  
  
This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
* End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
* Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
* Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
* Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for
  
  

* Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
* Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
* Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
* Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
* Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
  
  
Compliance
  
  
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
**Position Title:**
Supply Chain Manager

**Location:**
West Bengal, India

**Experience Required:**
7–10 years

**CTC:**
35 - 45 LPA

**Role Purpose**

The Supply Chain Manager will own the end-to-end supply chain and production planning for the Beauty, Cosmetic, Perfumes, Alcohol business, from production planning and vendor coordination through to finished-product availability. The role will build and manage the vendor ecosystem, including international suppliers, align production with business projections and sales requirements, and ensure that products are available at the right time and in the right quantities. The role is highly execution-oriented and requires strong ownership of timelines, vendors, inventory, production schedules and cross-functional coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Demand & Production Planning**

* Translate business projections, collection plans and sales forecasts into production requirements.
* Develop production plans based on expected demand, launch calendars, channel requirements and supplier lead times.
* Work closely with sales and merchandising teams to understand current and anticipated demand.
* Anticipate production requirements well in advance based on long lead-time components and international sourcing dependencies.
* Maintain visibility on production pipeline, committed quantities, expected receipts and potential supply gaps.
* Identify risks to product availability and proactively develop mitigation plans.

**End-to-End Vendor Management**

* Own relationships with domestic and international vendors involved in the supply chain.
* Identify, evaluate and onboard vendors in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders.
* Manage vendor negotiations around timelines, quantities, quality, costs and commercial terms.
* Establish vendor performance standards and review vendor performance regularly.
* Build strong relationships with international suppliers and manage communication across time zones and geographies.
* Ensure vendor adherence to agreed production and delivery timelines.

**Production & Component Coordination**

* Coordinate production of fragrance bottles, packaging components and other relevant product components.
* Track component-level production and identify dependencies that may affect finished-product timelines.
* Maintain detailed production trackers covering purchase orders, quantities, production status, quality approvals, dispatches and expected delivery dates.
* Coordinate with manufacturing/production partners to ensure timely completion of orders.
* Work with R&D and product teams during product development and transition from sampling to commercial production.

**Inventory & Availability**

* Establish appropriate inventory norms based on demand, lead times and business requirements.
* Monitor inventory levels and identify potential overstock, understock and stock-out situations.
* Develop replenishment plans based on sales velocity and production lead times.
* Ensure alignment between inventory availability and planned launches across channels.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with R&D, CPO, merchandising, retail, finance, HR and other relevant teams.
* Coordinate production plans with collection launch calendars.
* Align with sales teams on market requirements, upcoming demand and changes in projections.
* Work with Finance on purchase commitments, costing, working capital and vendor payments where required.
* Ensure supply-chain readiness for new launches and collection drops.

**Cost & Process Optimisation**

* Track product and component costs and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
* Support costing exercises and vendor negotiations.
* Identify opportunities to reduce lead times, improve MOQ economics and optimise inventory.
* Build scalable supply-chain processes, trackers and SOPs for the new fragrance business.

**International Supply Chain**

* Manage international vendor relationships and associated production timelines.
* Coordinate international shipments and ensure visibility on expected arrival dates.
* Work with relevant internal teams on documentation, logistics and import-related dependencies.
* Build contingency plans for critical international suppliers and long-lead components.

**Key Deliverables / Success Metrics**

* Production readiness for all planned launches
* On-time-in-full delivery from vendors
* Production lead-time adherence
* Inventory availability and stock-out levels
* Vendor performance
* Inventory turns / working capital efficiency
* Production cost optimisation
* Accuracy of demand-to-production planning
* Successful execution of new product launches

**Ideal Candidate**

* 5–8 years of experience in supply chain, sourcing, production planning or vendor management.
* Experience in fragrance, beauty, cosmetics, Alcohol, premium consumer goods or a highly design-led product environment preferred.
* Strong experience managing vendors, preferably including international suppliers.
* Experience working with long-lead-time components and production cycles.
* Strong understanding of demand planning, inventory management and production scheduling.
* Excellent stakeholder and vendor management skills.
* Strong analytical and Excel capabilities.
* Comfortable working in a start-up/0-to-1 environment where processes need to be built from scratch.
* Willingness to travel internationally/domestically for vendor management where required.

**Preferred Background**

Candidates from fragrance, cosmetics, beauty, premium consumer goods, fashion accessories, jewellery, Alcohol or other businesses involving complex vendor and component ecosystems may be considered.

**Issues, remediation, and partnership**

* Evaluate audit findings and control deficiencies; analyze relevant facts, assess potential impact, and develop and track remediation plans with SOX leadership and accountable stakeholders.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- PAM Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects and support practice build
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reports, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 5-7 years of experience in installing and implementing PAM solutions like CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Thycotic, Conjur/Hashicorp Vault
* Experience using Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and knowledge of Application container tools and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Image Registries
* Experience in integration of Conjur/Hashicorp Vault with enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps application (Jenkins, Ansible etc) will be an added advantage
* Experience in managing Windows/Linux environments and Database (PostgreSQL ideal)
* Proficiency in scripting languages- Python, JSON, Ruby, C#, PowerShell, YAML
* Knowledge of the function and use of REST APIs
* Working knowledge of common and industry standard cloud-native/cloud-friendly authentication mechanisms (OAuth, OpenID, etc)
* Define and describe Conjur/Hashicorp architecture, requirements, and workflow
* Integration of Secret Management solution with 3rd party solutions (LDAP/ SIEM)
* Ability to conduct workshops to understand existing service models, analyse DevOps procedures and security requirements, and identify required secret management functions and relevant use cases
* Supports and oversees the planning, maintenance and change management for risk system strategies, process changes, system parameter changes, production schedules, and operational tasks.
* Works with stakeholders to resolve issues and provide solutions that ensure service delivery and effectiveness.
* Ability to provide PAM best practices recommendations to the client
* Supports the development and maintenance of system and process documentation / process controls / knowledge assets required for the operation

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 5-7 years’ Work Experience
* CyberArk CDE or relevant product certification

**Certifications:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Hashicorp Vault/ CyberArk Conjur

**What We Look For**

* Who has hands on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
* Who has hands-on Development experience on Application and Directory Integration, User Provisioning, Okta Workflows, triggers, Rules and customizing the tool as per the requirements.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: USI | FY27 | Audit Services | SAP GITC - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Senior Consultant, Technology Controls Advisory, Audit and Assurance**
At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloitte’s clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success—and to the strength of the economy and public security.
  
  
By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today’s world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Senior consultant, you will build and nurture positive working relationships with Deloitte teams who work with clients with the intention to exceed client expectations. You will:
  
  

* Identify and evaluate complex business/ technological risks, internal controls which mitigate risks, and related opportunities for internal control improvement
* Perform system evaluation and/or audit IT and business process as a part of SOX 404, SSAE 18 or ICFR assessment in accordance with PCAOB/AICPA guidance using Deloitte methodology for whole point
* Perform complete GITC evaluation and testing across IT platform including, operating systems, databases, and network components
* Perform risk assessment for organizations to identify prioritized list of risk/audit
* Perform controls benchmarking to leading internal controls framework to identify gaps and excess controls
* Manage multiple assignments and demonstrate strong people management & networking skills
* Ensure timely completion of activities with quality, complete ownership of deliverables and early escalations to management, if required
* Play substantive/lead role on projects including project planning, economics, and managing quality
* Participate in proposal development efforts
* Assist in technical knowledge development and training efforts
* Demonstrate high level of understanding of internal and external client's business

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree
* MBA in Finance/Accounting /IT/Information security and or CA/CPA/CIA/CISA/CISSP

**Required Skills**

* 4-8 years of relevant work experience, with industry focus a plus
* Strong orientation toward internal control risk assessment, operational, and IT auditing
* Hands on experience on testing of SAP GITC controls(Change Management, Access Security, UAR) Test of design(TOD) and test of operating effectiveness (TOE)
* Have tested SAP Automated controls (3 way match, duplicate invoices, copy controls etc) across SAP ECC, S/4 HANA
* Experience of assessing and reviewing technology risks and controls over areas including access management, change management & computer operations for IT platforms (operating systems, databases, and network components)
* Exposure to any one industry—Financial Services; Technology, Media & Telecom; Life Sciences & Health Care; Energy & Resources; Consumer & Industrial Products
* Demonstrate MS office proficiency, problem solving & analytical skills, and strong verbal & written communication skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks, work on multiple assignments, manage ambiguity, and work independently or as part of a team with professionals at all levels

**Preferred Skills**

* Big Four experience preferred
* Hands-on experience/understanding of security (SAP ECC, S/4 HANA, GRC AC and PC, SAP B/W) and functioning of ERP (At least one of – SAP or Oracle EBS or JDE or Peoplesoft or Netsuite or Workday or SAP Ariba)
* Understanding of SAP Cloud will be added advantage

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Tech S and T-DC Exit and Cloud Migration Consultant-ISR-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**DC Exit & Cloud Migration Consultant - Senior**
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking a highly skilled DC Exit & Cloud Migration Senior Consultant with 6+ years of strong experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure modernization, datacenter transformation, and cloud migration initiatives across enterprise environments. The role focuses on planning, assessing, designing, and executing datacenter exit and cloud migration programs to accelerate application modernization, infrastructure optimization, operational resilience, and cloud adoption for enterprise clients.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on cloud engineering expertise combined with consulting experience and the ability to drive migration assessments, transformation roadmaps, proof-of-concepts, and migration execution across complex hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Assess, design, and execute datacenter exit and cloud migration strategies for enterprise applications, infrastructure, databases, and platforms.
* Perform application portfolio assessments and define migration approaches including Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retain, Retire, and Replace strategies.
* Develop cloud migration roadmaps, transformation plans, landing zones, and migration wave planning for enterprise clients.
* Strong competency in cloud engineering across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, including infrastructure provisioning, modernization, and workload migration.
* Design and implement cloud-native architectures leveraging compute, storage, networking, security, containers, and platform services.
* Support migration discovery, dependency mapping, infrastructure assessment, capacity planning, and migration readiness activities.
* Develop automation solutions using Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Shell scripting, and Infrastructure as Code principles to accelerate migration programs.
* Execute application, server, database, storage, and platform migrations while ensuring business continuity and operational stability.
* Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, networking, and operations teams to align migration initiatives with enterprise governance standards.
* Support cloud modernization initiatives involving containers, Kubernetes, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and Platform Engineering practices.
* Design and execute migration proof-of-concepts (PoCs), pilot migrations, validation activities, and cloud transformation assessments.
* Develop migration dashboards, reporting frameworks, business cases, and executive presentations to support client engagements.
* Provide technical advisory support on cloud adoption, application modernization, landing zone architecture, cloud governance, and migration best practices.
* Support cloud cost optimization, operational readiness, resiliency planning, and post-migration stabilization activities.

**Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Transformation, Datacenter Migration, Cloud Migration, and Technology Delivery.
* Strong understanding of datacenter exit strategies, cloud migration methodologies, and application modernization principles.
* Experience designing and executing migrations to Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, networking, storage, security, and identity management.
* Experience with virtualization platforms including VMware and hybrid cloud environments.
* Knowledge of migration assessment, dependency mapping, migration planning, and workload transformation frameworks.
* Experience working with Infrastructure as Code, automation frameworks, and cloud engineering practices.
* Experience working in client-facing consulting, advisory, or cloud transformation engagements.
* Strong problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Technical Expertise:**

* Strong expertise in cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience with cloud migration services including Azure Migrate, AWS Migration Hub, CloudEndure, Azure Site Recovery, AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), and related migration tools.
* Strong competency in infrastructure assessment, dependency mapping, migration planning, and workload transformation methodologies.
* Hands-on experience with Python, PowerShell, Shell Scripting, and Infrastructure Automation.
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, ARM Templates, Bicep, CloudFormation, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of compute, storage, networking, identity, security, backup, and disaster recovery services across cloud platforms.
* Experience with virtualization and hybrid cloud technologies including VMware, Hyper-V, and container-based platforms.
* Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
* Strong competency in DevOps and CI/CD tools including Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Git, and automation frameworks.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases including SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB, and Cosmos DB.
* Understanding of cloud governance, landing zones, operational readiness, observability, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience supporting application modernization, platform transformation, and cloud-native adoption initiatives.
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability platforms such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk, and Grafana.

title: Technology Specialist - Adobe Target Implementation
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Experience around 7 to 11 years, in Adobe Target implementation and experimentation along with Launch, Tagging, Analytics & Adobe Experience platform – WebSDK.
* WebSDK exposure is mandatory.
* Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3
* Strong experience in debugging client-side implementations, working with Browser developer tools, debugging frameworks and network requests.
* Expert level in implementing and troubleshooting A/B testing and personalization solutions with strong understanding of Single Page Applications (SPA) data layers, XDM schemas, event-driven tracking architectures.
* Experience with enterprise digital analytics and customer experience optimization programs.
* Exposure to Agile/Scrum, product development methodologies with a strong trait of collaboration
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

* B.E. / B. Tech

* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, analysts, and developers to translate experimentation requirements into scalable solutions.
* Ensure experimentation activities adhere to performance, accessibility, and governance standards.

* Develop and modify front-end experiences using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

* Troubleshoot and resolve implementation issues related to Adobe Target activities.
* Validate experiment execution across browsers, devices, and environments.
* Work closely with development teams to implement server-side and client-side experimentation solutions.

* Perform deep-dive debugging of Adobe Target implementations and experiment delivery issues.
* Analyze activity qualification, audience membership, mbox requests, profile scripts, and offer rendering issues.
* Investigate tracking discrepancies and identify root causes affecting experiment performance.
* Support production troubleshooting and incident resolution related to experimentation deployments.

* Partner with analytics teams to ensure experiments are measured correctly.

* Support integration between Adobe Target and Adobe Analytics.

title: SAP CFIN Consultant
description:
Job Description: SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultant
  
  
**Location:**
PAN India
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled
**SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultant**
with specialized expertise in Payment Factory, Electronic Bank Statement (EBS) processing, and In-House Bank (IHB) solutions.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing Central Finance solutions within SAP S/4HANA environments. You will ensure seamless integration between source systems, SAP CFIN, and banking platforms to support centralized payment processing, cash management, and automated financial operations.
  
  
Key ResponsibilitiesSolution Architecture & Implementation
  
  

* Design, build, and support end-to-end SAP Central Finance (CFIN) solutions in SAP S/4HANA landscapes.
* Lead and execute Payment Factory implementations utilizing Central Payment features within CFIN.
* Configure and maintain Central Payment processes for centralized vendor and customer payments.
* Set up and manage In-House Bank (IHB) configurations and operational workflows.

Banking & Treasury Integration
  
  

* Implement and manage Electronic Bank Statement (EBS) processing and automated bank statement ingestion.
* Configure Bank Account Management (BAM), cash positioning, payment processing, and treasury integration.
* Partner with banking partners and middleware teams to establish secure, scalable bank interfaces.

Data Replication & Error Handling
  
  

* Manage continuous financial transaction replication, mapping rules, and system reconciliations between source systems and target CFIN environments.
* Monitor, analyze, and resolve replication errors using SAP Application Interface Framework (AIF).

Stakeholder Management & Project Lifecycle
  
  

* Gather and translate business requirements into clear functional specifications, configuration documents, and process flow diagrams.
* Lead functional testing cycles, including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), cutover execution, and hypercare support.
* Provide end-user training and post-go-live support to ensure operational readiness.

**Qualifications & SkillsExperience Required**

* Overall Experience: 5–10 years of core SAP Financial Accounting (FI) implementation and support experience.
* CFIN & Payment Factory: Proven hands-on experience implementing SAP CFIN and Payment Factory solutions.
* Banking Solutions: Demonstrated expertise in EBS ingestion, Central Payment, and In-House Bank (IHB) configuration.
* S/4HANA: Direct hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance projects.

Technical & Functional Core Competencies
  
  

* Deep functional understanding of SAP FI (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Cash Management).
* Technical proficiency in AIF monitoring, error resolution, object mapping, and reconciliation frameworks.
* Solid understanding of financial data replication architectures across multi-ERP landscapes.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
* Proven ability to manage stakeholder expectations in high-visibility enterprise initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP S/4HANA Finance or Central Finance certification.
* Exposure to SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) or Advanced Payment Management (APM).
* Experience with multi-national, multi-currency implementations and complex banking formats (e.g., ISO 20022, MT940, BAI2).

title: Manager, Collections Strategy Delivery (L09)
description:
**Job Title: Manager, Collections Strategy Delivery (L09)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The
*Manager , Collections Strategy Delivery Build*
role is responsible for implementation of Collection strategies as they relate to Pre-Delinquent, Delinquent (pre-charge off) & Recovery accounts utilizing SAS, Experian Power Curve (Strategy Manager) and Fiserv Rules. The Analyst leads solution development with build team, direct manager and change requestor for new projects, new clients and Strategy Change Initiatives within Strategy Delivery Team. Analysis of collection strategies and development/ enhancement of Phone and Alternate channel implementation processes are key elements to the success of the Strategy Delivery Team. Participates on multiple initiatives as Build SME for SAS, Strategy Manager application and Fiserv Rules Platform. As a Manager, you are required to be proficient in handing projects and engaging with stakeholders independently.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implements Collections and Operational Strategy initiatives for all delinquent accounts and Strategy designated Pre-Delinquent & Recovery accounts leveraging leading edge technology to enhance customer experience.
* Partner with collections contact strategy team, collection operations and process owners to determine strategy implementation requirements and develop / ensure streamlined approaches to coding, unit testing and queuing process
* Works independently to provide Level of Effort for scoping and scheduling the change requests
* Project Manager / SME for collections projects involving Alternate channel strategies (SAS) and Phone channel strategies (Strategy manager processes)
* Provides recommendations for process enhancements based upon Design Reviews
* Develop and monitor dashboards including analysis, action plans and identification of process improvements support simplification strategies including life-cycle tools and treatments specific to champion/challenger strategies that include digital channels, and other outbound correspondence
* Partners with process owners in establishing procedures and requirements to ensure accurate and timely delivery with regulatory and compliance standards
* Partners with Collections Data Warehouse team and Enterprise Data Lake teams for issue resolution
* Provide account level research for understanding of Collection processing
* Work independently with minimum to moderate supervision
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience
* Minimum 2 + years of hands-on experience with SAS or knowledge of SAS programming
* Minimum 2 + years of experience with design, test and control environments working with large amounts of data
* Minimum 1+ years analytical and decision-making experience.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* 1 year of experience with FISERV/FD Rules/ Strategy Manager Development (batch mode)
* 1 year of Project Management Experience
* Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects concurrently with commitment to deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and present business results to management

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience

**Work Timings: 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST**
(WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: Systems Analyst
description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
  
  
**Job Function:**
The role is responsible for the technical delivery, data architecture, and operational support of Channel Data Management (CDM) solutions within a complex enterprise environment, with a strong focus on database design, SQL development, and ETL processes.
  
  
This position defines and delivers high‑value CDM enhancements while ensuring data integrity, system performance, and scalability. The role requires deep expertise in relational databases, data modeling, and query optimization, as well as hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines to support data ingestion, transformation, and integration across multiple systems.
  
  
This position partners closely with IT, Sales Operations, and Data Engineering teams to manage end-to-end data solutions—from requirements gathering and backlog prioritization to data pipeline development, production support, and analytics enablement. The role ensures high-quality, reliable data flows across platforms while translating complex technical and data concepts into actionable insights for both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  
  
The CDM System Analyst should be highly motivated and passionate about data systems, database technologies, and scalable application architecture. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in SQL scripting, data transformation logic, performance tuning, and troubleshooting data issues across distributed systems. This role requires full ownership of data processes and pipelines, with a commitment to continuously enhancing the CDM ecosystem, improving data quality, and strengthening application and data infrastructure resiliency.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* System Operations, Monitoring & Incident Management
* Provide technical expertise to manage and support complex IT architectures supporting CDM solutions.
* Perform daily CDM system monitoring, including data validation, batch/job execution, and overall system health.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data quality and system issues identified through monitoring activities.
* Manage incidents and changes in alignment with the ITIL framework, including escalation to IT teams and tracking through resolution.
* Maintain, test, and continuously improve business and system operations to ensure stability and performance of 24x7 applications.
* Processes, Technical Solutions, Data & Analytics Enablement
* Support CDM Operations, Geo Sales Operations, and Data-to-Value teams with issue resolution, data loads, mass data updates, and technical guidance.
* Develop SQL-based solutions to support reporting and analytics needs, including Power BI datasets and reports.
* Build and maintain Business Objects Universes and reports.
* Design and deliver solutions using Microsoft Power BI and Power Platform tools.
* Maintain a holistic view of CDM processes and users to assess functional impacts across configuration, workflows, integrations, and reporting.
* Apply deep understanding of CDM business processes and related enterprise systems, including ERP, PLM, CRM, and the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Stakeholder Collaboration, Communication & Enablement
* Work closely with technology and operations teams to ensure successful, sustainable delivery of CDM systems, including transitions to IT operations.
* Provide regular project and operational updates (weekly/monthly), and confidently brief executive audiences to support informed, proactive decision-making.
* Report risks, issues, and progress to IT leadership, escalating as appropriate.
* Develop, deliver, and support training for CDM operations and key user teams, enabling adoption and effective system usage.
* Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Experience and Background:**
**Work History:**

* 5+ years of experience in designing solutions and defining requirements for CDM platforms and complex IT systems, including hands-on experience with databases, SQL, ETL processes, and related data systems..
* Excellent communication skills and customer service skills
* Must have strong problem-solving ability, critical thinking skills, creative/innovative thinking, attention to detail, and previous systems/business analyst experience.
* Must show positive attitude, strong self-motivation, ability to meet deadlines, and ability to determine appropriate sense of urgency.
* Good understanding of software development life cycles.

**Technical Competence:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems or closely related field.
* Expertise in Data warehouse and ETL tools like BODS (Business Objects Data Services), DataStage, Business Objects, AWS Aurora and AWS Redshift.
* Must have knowledge in IT Development, Production support or Operations area.
* Extensive working experience in SQL Query or other programming languages.
* Must have knowledge in Microsoft office tools, particularly Excel, VBA and Access.
* Nice to have knowledge of web applications, portals and document management tools.
* Nice to have knowledge of webMethods or any such integration tools.
* Nice to have knowledge of SAP HANA, Microsoft D365, Enovia or similar tools in ERP, CRM and PLM.
* Nice to have knowledge in Power Platform apps, Power BI, Power App, Power Automate/ Flow.
* Experience in project management skills.

**Skills:**

* Oral & Written Communication.
* Strong problem solving, critical thinking
* Ability to be a global team player, communicate and work well in a collaborative environment.
* Be proactive in resolving issues and delivering business solutions.
* Handling Confidential & Sensitive Data & Information.
* Process Facilitation.

title: Business Coach, Amazon, VAS-Category
description:
**Description**
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses during a transformational time.
  
  
The Business Coach finds and executes value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are setup for success.
  
  
Our Business Coaches are leaders and collaborators. They are analytical and creative; deadline-driven, organized and able to multi-task; and have strong interpersonal skills including a demonstrated ability to earn trust, inspire others, and be empathetic. You’ll be at the center of cross-functional teams, all working together to deliver the highest quality experience to Amazon customers.
  
  
If you're a dynamic, organized self-starter who’s ready to partner with our DSP owners as they launch and scale their business in one of the fastest growing industries in the world, we’d like to talk with you. Curious? Good, that’s one of our Leadership Principles! Discover more about the opportunity below.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**On a Daily Basis, Business Coaches Are Responsible For**
Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch.
  
  
Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp-up operations and prepare for peak periods.
  
  
Coordinating Business and Financial Health Reviews to discuss business performance and new opportunities, as well as to provide benchmarking data and insights.
  
  
Identifying workflow inefficiencies and working to formulate and implement operational improvements at the network level and to improve the individual DSP owner experience.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As a Business Coach, you will partner with 20-40 DSP owners assigned to delivery stations across IN. You’ll work closely with a portfolio of owners at different stages as they set strategy, help drive accountability and engagement, and motivate and track key performance metrics. You’ll collaborate with an integrated internal team of Station Operations Managers, Program Managers, and Compliance and Finance personnel to ensure owners launch and scale their business in compliance with program requirements. Together, you’ll provide best-in-class support for owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level. You’ll accomplish this by analyzing problems, discovering insights, delivering recommendations, and driving change both internally and externally.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

title: SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant
description:
Job Description: Senior SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant
  
  
Position Overview
  
  

* Position: Senior SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant
* Experience Required: 8 to 10+ years
* Location / Mode: PAN India / Hybrid
* Project Type: Implementation, Roll-outs, Support, Change Requests, and Enhancements

Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic
**Senior SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant**
with a strong track record of end-to-end implementations and business process re-engineering. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise across core and advanced SAP CO modules, exceptional stakeholder communication skills, and hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA environments. You will lead requirement gathering, solution building, gap analysis, and month-end closing cycles while coordinating closely with technical teams.
  
  
**Mandatory Requirements & Core Skills**

* Experience: 8–10+ years of cumulative IT experience specializing in SAP Controlling (CO).
* Communication: EXCELLENT verbal and written communication skills with proven ability in client-facing roles, blueprinting, and user training.
* SAP S/4HANA Knowledge: Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA differences compared to ECC (e.g., Universal Journal integration, Material Ledger enhancements, CO-PA architecture).
* Project Lifecycle: Hands-on participation in at least 2+ full-cycle implementations, roll-outs, or major support/enhancement projects from requirement gathering to Go-Live.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Core SAP CO Modules:

+ General Controlling, Cost Center Accounting (CO-OM-CCA), and Profit Center Accounting (EC-PCA).
+ Product Costing (CO-PC) covering Make-to-Stock (MTS) and Make-to-Order (MTO) scenarios.
+ Material Ledger (ML) and profitability analysis (CO-PA), including Report Painter, CO-PA Realignment, and Top-Down Distribution.

+ Overhead management (Overhead keys, Overhead groups).
+ Advanced costing methods: Additive costing, Job costing, Batch costing, Mixed costing, Joint product, By-product, and Co-product costing.

+ Lead Business Process Re-engineering (BPR), Solution Building, Blueprinting, and GAP Analysis.
+ Design and execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and prepare comprehensive user manuals and training documentation.

By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth. You will collaborate with subject matter experts to deliver training needs analysis, curriculum design, and blended training solutions, using industry-standard tools to create engaging learning assets. Your ability to adapt to changing priorities and work across time zones will validate seamless project execution and client satisfaction.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Designing and implementing learning solutions to support client transformation initiatives
* Collaborating with Subject Matter Experts to conduct Training Needs Analysis and develop curriculum

* Supporting engagement delivery through phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation
* Facilitating workshops and presentations using various collaboration tools
* Providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members to enhance their development
* Staying informed on the latest trends in learning and development to contribute to internal initiatives
* Developing and presenting innovative ideas and solutions to clients and stakeholders
* Building and maintaining client relationships to support organizational change management efforts
* Analyzing business operations and ERP solutions to align learning strategies with organizational goals

What You Must Have
  
  

* 4-8 years of prior relevant experience in consulting
* Master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Education (M.Ed.), Communications, HR, Organizational Development or Psychology.
* Certification in Instructional Design or Learning Experience Design (e.g., ATD/CPTD, Articulate, or an equivalent recognized ID credential) is required, while PROSCI or other Change Management certifications are preferred and considered an added advantage.
* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.
* Will to work in a fast-paced environment with sometimes unpredictable circumstances or changes, comfortable working in ambiguity.
* Demonstrating proficiency in AI tools for workforce solutions
* Utilizing analytical thinking to assess training effectiveness
* Collaborating with engagement managers to address client needs
* Exhibiting ability to work independently and in teams
* Supporting client-facing consulting engagements and mentoring juniors
* Leveraging AI-human collaboration for enhanced productivity

Kass • Full-Time Opportunity • Kolkata

Creative / Design Head

**Location :**
Kolkata (Work From Office)

2–3+ Years • Immediate to 30 Days

Kass is a premium D2C skincare brand built around
**Bio-Intelligent Skincare -**
thoughtfully formulated solutions designed to address skin concerns at their foundation and support long-term skin health.Building a premium brand goes far beyond creating pretty graphics. It requires a distinctive visual language, a cohesive brand ecosystem, and high-velocity operational pipelines that consistently deliver theatrical-grade assets. We are looking for a
**Creative/Design Head**
who understands how modern, premium D2C brands operate, commands the production floor, and knows how to lead a multidisciplinary creative department to drive tangible brand scale.

**The Role**

As the
**Creative/Design Head**
, you will own Kass’s entire visual and creative direction across all touchpoints - digital performance campaigns, brand films, 3D simulations, physical packaging, and retail presence.You will lead, mentor, and direct a high-output multidisciplinary team (video editors, 3D motion artists and graphic designers), acting as the ultimate strategic and aesthetic filter for the brand. Beyond creative leadership, you will build and optimize the operational pipelines and automations that allow the team to scale output without sacrificing a premium, "million-dollar" brand finish.

**Key Responsibilities1. Creative Direction & Brand Architecture**

* **Define, protect, and evolve**
  Kass’s overall visual identity and brand guidelines across digital, physical packaging, e-commerce, and offline touchpoints.
* **Translate complex, clinical, and bio-intelligent formulations**
  into sophisticated, scroll-stopping narratives and high-converting visual assets.
* Ensure every frame, static, and render meets an uncompromising, premium aesthetic standard.

**2. Multidisciplinary Team Leadership**

* **Direct, mentor, and maintain rigorous quality control**
  over a high-output creative floor comprising Video Editors, Graphic Designers and 3D Motion Artists.
* **Act as the primary strategic filter**
  for all campaigns—reviewing daily cuts, static creatives, narrative hooks, and 3D explainers to eliminate friction before deployment.
* **Plan, delegate, and manage project workflows**
  based on priorities, launch timelines, and individual strengths, fostering a culture of ownership and execution speed.

**3. Production & On-Set Command**

* **Bridge practical filmmaking with digital post-production**
  —lead on-set shoots, direct macro camera setups and lighting, and establish a rich, organic visual vocabulary for new product drops.
* **Supervise high-fidelity post-production**
  , including dynamic motion tracking, kinetic typography, and seamless 3D/CGI product integration.
* **Lead the production**
  of both top-of-funnel cinematic brand films and rapid-iteration performance creatives (Reels, Meta ads, short-form video).

**4. Pipeline Architecture & Workflow Optimization**

* **Build, maintain, and streamline**

description:

**Key Responsibilities**
